en-US.description:
#SaudiArabia #ArabTravel #ArabBoys

Hello everyone! This is Leo J :)
This travel vlog is about our Arab trip!! We went to the unknown world of Saudi Arabia.
The three of us, Chomad and Joepmi, formed the Arab Boys and went there. Haha
Ha... First off, let me get to the point... It's such a fantastic and exotic place that I can't help but say it's crazy... I absolutely, absolutely recommend you go there before you die!
It was so great to be with Chomad (Jowon), who helped us film this trip with so many Arab friends, and our angel Joepmi, who treated us like brothers, even more than other brothers, throughout the trip!

Soon, I'll be uploading a vlog about our Dubai trip after Saudi Arabia~
It's a city of endless wealth. Haha, unimaginable episodes await you. Please look forward to it!! Enjoy this video too!!

🧡Saudi Arabia AlUla Travel Itinerary🧡

1️⃣ Emirates First Class
They offer a chauffeur service where a car and driver pick you up when you board and disembark.
It was super convenient because you could use it as a place to stay when you travel from home to Incheon Airport or when you disembark at Dubai Airport.
There are two aircraft types: the A380 and the B777, each with their own pros and cons, but we chose the A380 because it has a private shower and an inflight lounge!

2️⃣ Pink Camel Pastry Boutique (Cafe next to a farm)
A lovely brunch cafe located next to AlUla Old Town! The food is delicious and the view is amazing.
I was worried because there aren't many restaurants or cafes in AlUla, but it was fantastic!

3️⃣ Our Habitas AlUla (Hotel)
This is one of the most luxurious resorts in AlUla, so I really wanted to visit. The pool was especially beautiful, making me want to stay forever. ㅠㅠ
It's a resort built on the desert, so exotic. It feels like Aladdin, lol.

4️⃣ Tama (Hotel Dining)
This restaurant within Habitas Resort offers a fusion of Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cuisine!

5️⃣ Harrat Viewpoint (Viewpoint)
This viewpoint is located atop the volcanic Harrat Uwayrid. The sunset is truly breathtaking.

6️⃣ Hegra Tour
Hegra is Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO World Heritage Site and was once the capital of the ancient Nabataean Kingdom. 
The Nabataean Tombs are a 2-3 hour tour, and advance reservations are required!

7️⃣ Elephant Rock
This place features a giant rock elephant sculpture. There's a cafe in front of the rock where you can have a campfire, so everyone takes tons of photos there. It's definitely a hot spot in AlUla.

8️⃣ Maraya Concert Hall
I saw it on social media and really wanted to see it in person! A massive glass building in the middle of the desert, it feels like it was built by aliens. It's even the world's largest mirrored structure, so it's truly magnificent and mystical. Maraya means "mirror" in Arabic!

🌱Foodology Olive Oil (~42% OFF + Extra Free Gift!)
This is the olive oil I've been drinking every morning on an empty stomach lately!
I'm really sensitive to bloating, but I've definitely noticed a difference since I've been taking it every day.
There's a promotion going on at the link below, so
I highly recommend trying the convenient capsule version for those of you who are interested in olive oil! https://food-ology.co.kr/product/detail.html?product_no=2429&cafe_mkt=ue_2

en.title: There’s no other word for it... absolutely insane 🔥 I traveled to AlUla, the royal city
en.description:
There’s no other word for it... absolutely insane 🔥 I traveled to AlUla, the royal city of “Saudi Arabia.” | LeoJ Travel Vlog



#SaudiArabia #ArabTravel #ArabBoys

Hi everyone! This is LeoJ :)
This travel vlog is all about our trip to the Arab world! We headed to the mysterious land of Saudi Arabia, 
and Chomad, Cho Jebmi, and I formed the “Arab Boys” and went together.
Sigh... to sum it up first... it was truly unreal. So fantastical and exotic that there are no words other than “insane.” I seriously want to tell you, go at least once before you die.
I’m so grateful to Chomad (Chowon), who helped us film with so many Arab friends during this trip, and our angel Jebmi, who took care of us like the real big brother the whole time. It was such a great trip thanks to them!

Next up, we moved from Saudi to Dubai, so a Dubai travel vlog is coming soon!
That place is on another level, the endless city of wealth. Episodes beyond imagination are waiting. Stay tuned! Enjoy this video too!

🧡 Saudi Arabia AlUla Travel Course 🧡

1️⃣ Emirates First Class
When flying, they offer a chauffeur service, private car and driver both when departing and upon arrival. So we could use it from home to Incheon Airport, and from Dubai Airport to our hotel. So convenient!
There are two aircraft types: A380 and B777. Each has pros and cons, but we purposely chose the A380 because it has an onboard shower and lounge!

2️⃣ Pink Camel Pastry Boutique (Farmside Café)
A vibe-filled brunch café next to AlUla Old Town!! The food was seriously delicious and the view was insane.
We were worried since AlUla doesn’t have many restaurants or cafés, but this place was amazing!

3️⃣ Our Habitas AlUla (Hotel)
One of the top luxury resorts in AlUla, I really wanted to visit.
The pool is so beautiful you’ll never want to leave.
Built in the desert, it feels incredibly exotic, like becoming Aladdin.

4️⃣ Tama (Hotel Dining)
A restaurant inside the Habitas resort serving Mediterranean + Middle Eastern fusion cuisine!

5️⃣ Harrat Viewpoint
Located at the top of the volcanic Harrat Uwayrid formation, the sunset here is beyond words...

6️⃣ Hegra Tour
Hegra is Saudi Arabia’s first UNESCO World Heritage Site. It was once the capital of the ancient Nabataean Kingdom.
You can tour the Nabataean tombs for about 2~3 hours, and reservations are required in advance!

7️⃣ Elephant Rock
A massive elephant-shaped rock formation. There’s a cafe area with campfires in front of it, and everyone takes their “lifetime shots” here. Definitely an AlUla hot spot!

8️⃣ Maraya Concert Hall
A place I saw on social media and had to see with my own eyes!
A giant mirrored building stands in the middle of the desert, like aliens left it there? It’s actually the largest mirrored building in the world, so it felt incredibly grand and mystical.
“Maraya” means “mirror” in Arabic!

I’m really sensitive to bloating, but after taking it daily, I can definitely feel the difference.
